files.description: Four fictional tickets with a zero-minute record
Corrected reference with optional filter and local export
Independent boundary and command acceptance tests

tasks.title: Understand the requested change
tasks.goal: Investigate the supplied legacy command and write a short, testable change brief.
steps: Read CONTRACT.md and the relevant brief in projects.md.
Attempt the change in a copy, then compare against the reference.
Use the supplied tests to study the contract; point your own tests at your attempt.

commands.label: Run reference acceptance checks
commands.expected: All reference tests pass; the legacy comparison demonstrates the known defect.

notes: This kit uses only the Python standard library. Tests use temporary folders and fictional records.
The reference tests do not grade your separately edited starter.
